$comment: The constants and derivations of the tick, as data. tick-protocol.md is the procedure — what the tick does, in order, and why — and points here for every number and every predicate, so a threshold has one home instead of appearing in a prose table, a nudge text, and SKILL.md. scripts/derive-workspace-state.mjs evaluates derived_states, which is what makes this file the source rather than a second copy of one.

tick_lock_stale_minutes.why: A tick_in_progress older than this is a crashed tick's lock, not a running tick. Long enough to exceed a healthy tick, short enough that a crash self-heals within one /loop interval.

tick_target_seconds.why: Work per tick. Under the goal driver the turn then waits the per-tick floor before ending.

max_wraps_per_tick.why: A wrap writes product-context.yaml and moves git refs on the integration branch. Two in one tick race each other; simultaneous completions wrap across consecutive ticks.

max_retries.why: Attempts on a failed story before it escalates instead of re-dispatching.

retrigger_after_ticks.why: Ticks with no response to a gen/eval trigger before re-triggering with the urgent text (~15 min).

escalate_after_attempts.why: Trigger attempts before the workspace escalates as eval_not_converging rather than being nudged again.

merge_stuck_ticks.why: Ticks at phase 12 without progress before the stronger merge nudge. Lower than the general ladder because a stalled merge is a known, recoverable shape, not an unknown stall.

stuck_ladder.detail: Check blockers. If the workspace declared any, log and leave it alone — a declared blocker is not silence.
executor.nudge() with the stuck text in tick-protocol.md Step ⑤. On claude-bg this is also the stop+respawn threshold.
Add a stuck escalation. Consider pausing when the story is on the critical path.

derived_states.$comment: The autopilot keeps no FSM enum: a workspace's logical state is derived from its fields each tick. Ordered — first match wins, which is what disambiguates phase 11 (CI/Review loop) from phase 12+ (Awaiting merge). Stuck is deliberately NOT in this list: it is orthogonal to progress (a workspace can be stuck while Implementing), so it is a flag below rather than a state that would mask where the work actually stands.

flags.detail: At or past the nudge rung of the stuck ladder.
Waiting on a human answer in the main session — gated, not stuck, and exempt from stuck counting.
